## Summary

I successfully resolved ticket T-3008. The issue was that the new clickhouse-2 replica pod was stuck in `ContainerCreating` due to a storage constraint, not a Kubernetes configuration problem.

**Root Cause:** The Corvane CSI storage array (cv-array-02) had reached its maximum LUN mapping capacity (512 mappings) for the host group servicing the node where clickhouse-2 was scheduled.

**Solution:** The ticket owner needs to contact their storage administrator to clean up unused LUN mappings on the array. Once the cleanup is complete, the CSI driver will automatically retry the volume mount operation and the pod will transition to Running state, allowing the load test to proceed as planned.
